title: Rory and the Starlit Lagoon
verses:
As the moon rises high over valleys of green,
Rory paused on the ridge as the breezes blew chill.
A soft blanket of mist wrapped the sleepy ravine,
While the stars started glowing above the cool hill.

Nia flew through the dusk with a flash of her wings,
Calling out to her friends from the canopy height.
Psittaco chirped a tune that the evening wind sings,
As they followed a blossom that sparkled with light.

Down the path to the lake where the lotus buds sway,
Benny stepped through the reeds with a satisfied sigh.
Tilly gathered blue moss at the end of the day,
Underneath the pale glow of the slumbering sky.

Ricky curled in the grass with his eyelids pressed tight,
Feeling cozy and warm in the hollow of fern.
Psittaco nestled deep in the quiet of night,
Watching fireflies dance as they shimmer and turn.

Rory rested his head on a cushion of stone,
Listening close to the breath of his friends all around.
Not a creature was left feeling lost or alone,
On the soft velvet soil of the slumbering ground.

Now the shadow falls long and the valley is still,
As the silver moon shines on the canopy tree.
Every dinosaur sleeps on the slumbering hill,
Drifting off into dreams by the glittering sea.
